articles.hausa_translation: Gwamnatin Jihar Zamfara ta gabatar da Tsarin Ajiyar Bayanan Lafiya ta Lantarki (EHR) a Asibitin Likitawa Ahmad Sani Yariman Bakura, Gusau, a matsayin wata hanyar haɓaka samar da aiki na lafiya ta hanyar fasaha ta zamani. articles.hausa_translation: Zamfara ta karfafa hanyar gaida gaida ga matan jiya da sabuwar jiya, saniya a gida da waje
